messages:
Harper: Flagging LumenAI renewal invoice INV-96003 6 the platform fee was split into two lines with different tax treatment (one line marked VAT-exempt, other with VAT). AR and the customer's AP both rejected it. Can we reconcile? :warning:
Miguel: Can you paste the exported lines from the billing system? Curious if it's a data model split (licensing vs services) or a tax tagging issue.
Harper: Exported lines:
- PLATFORM_LICENSING  100,000.00  GL:PLAT-7000  VAT:exempt
- PLATFORM_SERVICES    20,000.00  GL:PLAT-7001  VAT:charged (20%)
Total: 120,000.00
Customer contract AMND-2024-02 shows a single Platform Fee 120,000 and expects reverse-charge VAT handling (they are EU VAT-registered).
Jules: Ah5 the migration to the new tax engine split the fee into "licensing" vs "services" so one part inherited VAT rules for services. For reverse-charge we need a single non-VAT line with a reverse-charge note. This is more than a cosmetic consolidation; tax treatment matters.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-96003 created by billing-worker at 2078905549. Tax engine: new-v2.
Miguel: Two paths: 1) Issue corrective invoice INV-96003-R1 consolidating into one platform fee line and mark as reverse-charge with VAT id note; create credit memo CM-621 to void the two lines. 2) Post GL/journal to reclass and then update tax code on the existing invoice lines (but many EU AP systems prefer a single line for reverse charge). Which is less disruptive to LumenAI's AP?
Harper: I spoke with LumenAI AP on a quick call. They insisted on a single line with reverse-charge note so their ERP can auto-post. They asked us to avoid multiple tax-coded lines. Option 1 preferred.
Jules: We also need tax sign-off because changing the VAT treatment mid-cycle can affect our VAT reporting. @tax-bot can you advise whether credit+reissue is safe from a VAT reporting standpoint for the quarter?
tax-bot: Quick check: credit + reissue is permissible. Ensure memo includes original invoice and VAT id: LU-987654321. Post a reversal journal referencing PR-7488 for audit. Do not alter original invoice date in case audit needs it.
Miguel: Thanks. Proposed steps: 1) Create CM-621 to void PLATFORM_LICENSING and PLATFORM_SERVICES lines 2) Reissue INV-96003-R1 with single PLATFORM_FEE 120,000, VAT reverse-charge note, include VAT id LU-987654321 in memo 3) Post PR-7488 to record reversal and rebooking to PLAT-7000. ETA 1 business day.
Harper: Also please add a short note in memo: "Reverse-charge per AMND-2024-02. Consolidated platform fee." Customer asked we include their purchase order PO-7788 in the new invoice.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-621 at 2078905800 by billing-worker.
Miguel: Posted PR-7488 at 2078906000 linking CM-621 and INV-96003-R1. GL reclass PLAT-7001 -> PLAT-7000 completed. Tax flag updated to reverse-charge.
Miguel: INV-96003-R1 issued at 2078906050. Memo: "Consolidated platform fee. Reverse-charge VAT per AMND-2024-02. Customer VAT: LU-987654321. Ref: INV-96003, PO-7788." Emailed to ap@lumenai.example.
billing-bot: AR import processed at 2078906100. Status: Success.
Nora: Confirmed with LumenAI AP 5 they received INV-96003-R1 and matched it in their ERP. Payment release scheduled. Thanks team.
Harper: I'll open an engineering ticket to change the tax engine mapping for platform consolidations so licensing+services don't split tax codes for consolidated contracts. Filing FR-9555 to track.
Jules: Adding a quick audit note: keep copies of INV-96003 and INV-96003-R1 in the tax folder. Good catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
